corrections.text: The article quotes the GitHub release notes as describing "Backward compatibility with `.aup3` conversion." That exact phrase does not appear in the release notes. The release notes actually state: ".aup3 projects open and convert to .aup4 without changing the original file. Converted projects cannot be saved back to .aup3." The one-way conversion described in the article is accurate; the quoted phrasing was not verbatim.
